title: ID0435499-DC/Si-D/AT-[MP / S0 170004171] Charger outlets unavailable
description:
Reported behavior/issue:Charger outlets unavailable
Answer: Charger went offline due to possible upstream problem. Since FC14 is not tripped and we lost all logs, that means that the charger went offline from something other than the charger

I checked the logs from this date and here are my findings:
After a reboot, both outlets were online and green, but

Let me know if this is what you required.
Thanks!

additional_info.subject: ID0435499-DC/Si-D/AT-[MP / S0 170004171] Charger outlets unavailable CRM:02919000103
additional_info.body:
Hi Johannes,
Thanks for the feedback.
From our side, we can only be 100% sure if there was a problem on our side if we visited the charger when the problem occured.
It's very unlikely for the PLC to stop suddenly, it would have to be FC14 tripped, but when charger is back online I don't see the error of the fuse being tripped, since it must be untripped on-site.
From what I see, there was a problem with upstream somehow in MV or similar.
I'm sorry I can't provide much detail.
Let me know if I can close the ticket.
Thanks!
Best regards,
Francisco
